name: Smarter Furnishings
old_description: From custom designs to existing collections, we simplify the complex world of contract furniture so you can focus on the bigger picture. Whether it’s student housing, hospitality, or beyond, our goal is to make every project smoother, every partnership stronger, and every space
about:
Smarter Furnishings is based in Alabaster, Alabama. The company is owned by three partners — Brian Tipton, Chief Customer Officer; Dean Harvison, Chief Growth Officer; and Johnny Collins, Chief Executive Officer — who remain actively involved in daily operations. While the founding year is not publicly disclosed, the leadership team emphasizes hands-on involvement from estimating through installation.

The firm supplies contract furniture for education, hospitality, and government projects, offering both custom designs and existing collections. It manages production through an approval phase followed by a 12- to 16-week manufacturing lead time, and provides on-campus and off-campus installation services. The company highlights quality craftsmanship, on-time delivery, and a 25-year warranty on its products.

Clients include universities outfitting student housing, hotels and resorts, and government agencies. The company’s portfolio references collegiate spaces, hospitality environments, and government facilities, with testimonials noting reliable student room furniture and responsive project management.

Smarter Furnishings positions itself as a partner that simplifies the complex procurement of contract furniture. Its stated mission is to be the trusted partner of choice for thoughtfully designed, expertly delivered furnishings, with senior leadership directly overseeing estimating, installation, and follow-up to ensure project success.
